item.title: President Lee’s Issue-Driven ‘SNS Communication’… Controversy Over Outbursts Also Rises (이슈 주도하는 이 대통령 ‘SNS 소통’…돌출 발언 논란도)
item.description:
As he marks his first year in office, President Lee Jae-myung’s active use of social media (SNS) stands out as the most distinctive feature differentiating him from former presidents. By transparently and candidly sharing his thoughts, he has increased public satisfaction. However, the risks posed by impromptu remarks cannot be ignored, leading to calls for more refined message management. (취임 1년째를 맞는 이재명 대통령의 활발한 에스엔에스(SNS) 소통은 전직 대통령들과 구별되는 가장 큰 특징으로 꼽힌다. 대통령의 생각을 투명하고 가감 없이 공개함으로써 국민들이 체감하는 만족도는 높아졌지만, 돌출 발언에 따른 리스크도 무시할 수 없어 정제된 메시지 관리가 필요하다는 지적도 나온다.)

Just four days after taking office, on June 8 last year, President Lee posted his first message on X (formerly Twitter), signaling the start of his SNS communication effort. Over the past year, from his inauguration to the 27th, he has written about 600 posts on X, averaging one to two per day. It is reported that President Lee personally writes SNS posts when he needs to deliver immediate and consistent messages to the market or when he judges that government ministries are moving too slowly. ( 이 대통령은 취임 나흘 만인 지난해 6월8일 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 첫 글을 올리며 에스엔에스 소통 행보를 시작했다. 취임 뒤부터 27일까지 1년간 작성한 엑스 글은 600여건으로, 하루 평균 1~2건꼴로 에스엔에스에 글을 올렸다. 이 대통령은 시장에 즉각적이고 일관된 메시지를 전달할 필요가 있거나, 정부 부처의 일 처리 속도가 상대적으로 더디다고 판단하는 경우 직접 에스엔에스에 글을 작성하는 것으로 전해졌다.)

President Lee’s eloquent style has been well-suited to the rapid spread of SNS. Using easy-to-understand analogies and concise messages, he proposes policies or raises controversial topics, nimbly steering public discourse. This is the backdrop against which the president’s SNS has emerged as a platform for social debate. His SNS activity has transcended mere promotional channels to become a key driver of national governance. ( 달변인 이 대통령의 스타일은 전파력이 빠른 에스엔에스와 상성이 잘 맞았다. 이해하기 쉬운 비유와 간결한 메시지로 정책을 제안하거나 논쟁적 화두를 던지며, 기민하게 이슈를 주도했다. 대통령의 에스엔에스가 사회적 공론화의 장으로 부상한 배경이다. 이 대통령의 에스엔에스는 단순한 홍보 창구를 넘어 국정 운영의 주요 동력이 됐다.)

This approach was most pronounced in real estate policy. By repeatedly sending out strong messages—such as eradicating real estate speculation and regulating multi-homeowners—he achieved the effect of curbing rising property prices. Inside the presidential office, it is believed that the president’s SNS messages, acting as proactive signals to the market, played a key role. ( 이런 지점이 가장 두드러진 부분은 부동산 정책이었다. 부동산 투기 근절, 다주택자 규제 등 고강도 메시지를 반복적으로 발신하면서 부동산 상승세를 억제하는 효과를 거뒀다. 청와대 내부에서도 이 대통령의 에스엔에스 메시지가 시장에 선제적인 시그널로 작동한 것이 주효했다고 본다.)

This has also led to increased trust in state affairs. Compared to the previous administration, which was frequently embroiled in controversies over lack of communication, it has given the impression that decision-making at the presidential office is relatively transparent. In various opinion polls, ‘communication’ is cited as the main reason for positive evaluations of President Lee’s performance, a finding interpreted in the same vein. Professor Lee Jae-mook of the Department of Political Science and International Relations at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies said, “Under the presidential system, the public expects the president to know everything. From the public’s perspective, the president’s direct communication helps alleviate feelings of frustration or curiosity.” ( 국정 신뢰도 향상으로도 이어졌다. 불통 논란이 잦았던 지난 정부와 견줘 청와대 의사결정이 비교적 투명하게 이뤄진다는 인상을 심어준 것이다. 여러 여론조사 결과에서 ‘소통’이 이 대통령의 국정 수행을 긍정 평가하는 주된 이유로 꼽히는 것도 같은 맥락으로 풀이된다. 이재묵 한국외대 정치외교학과 교수는 “대통령제에서 국민들은 대통령만큼은 모든 걸 다 알고 있을 거라 기대한다”며 “국민들 입장에선 대통령의 직접 소통으로 답답함이나 궁금증 같은 것이 해소되는 효과가 있다”고 말했다.)

However, there are significant concerns that because the president writes his own SNS posts, unpolished messages may slip through. A representative example is his post on the 10th of last month, where he shared a video claiming the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) had tortured a Palestinian child before throwing him off a rooftop, adding, “I need to find out if this is true, and if so, what actions were taken.” After it was later confirmed that the video was from two years ago, showing Israeli soldiers dropping a Palestinian corpse, opposition parties criticized that inaccurate facts had led to diplomatic conflicts. Similarly, a post on the 19th criticizing a seven-year-old advertisement by fashion commerce company Musinsa drew puzzled reactions. Even though the ad had been criticized for evoking the death of Park Jong-cheol from police torture and Musinsa had already apologized, President Lee remarked, “I need to check if this is real.” (하지만 대통령이 직접 에스엔에스에 글을 작성하다 보니 다듬어지지 않은 메시지가 나갈 수 있다는 우려도 크다. 가령 이 대통령이 지난달 10일 이스라엘방위군(IDF)이 팔레스타인 어린이를 고문한 뒤 옥상에서 떨어뜨렸다고 주장하는 영상을 공유하며 “이게 사실인지, 사실이라면 어떤 조치가 있었는지 알아봐야겠다”고 쓴 글이 대표적이다. 이후 이 영상이 2년 전 이스라엘군이 팔레스타인인의 주검을 떨어뜨린 장면으로 확인되면서 야당에서는 부정확한 사실관계로 외교 갈등을 초래했다는 비판이 쏟아졌다. 패션 커머스 기업 무신사의 7년 전 광고를 비판한 지난 19일 글을 두고도 의아하다는 반응이 뒤따랐다. 해당 광고가 박종철 고문치사 사건을 연상시킨다는 비판을 받고 무신사가 사과한 사안임에도 이 대통령은 “진짜인지 확인해봐야겠다”고 언급했다.)

Kim Bong-shin, CEO of the polling firm Metavoice, pointed out, “Given that the president’s messages must carry authority and weight, SNS posts come with a heavy burden.” Professor Kim Yun-cheol of the Humanitas College at Kyung Hee University noted, “Given the nature of SNS, mistakes can occur and discord between the presidential office and the ruling party may be exposed. Since the positive effects are also significant, there is a need to consider regularizing and formalizing the process.” ( 여론조사 업체 메타보이스 김봉신 대표는 “대통령의 메시지에는 권위와 무게가 실려야 한다는 점에서 에스엔에스 글들은 부담이 크다”고 짚었다. 김윤철 경희대 후마니타스칼리지 교수는 “에스엔에스 특성상 실수가 나올 수도 있고 당정 간 엇박자가 노출될 우려도 있다”며 “긍정적 효과도 큰 만큼 정례화·형식화를 고민할 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporters: Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr, Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 심우삼 wu32@hani.co.kr 서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ultra-tight Daegu race: Kim Boo-kyum says "Elect me for one stone, three birds"; Choo Kyung-ho vows "I'll bring the money" (초박빙 대구, 김부겸 “나 뽑으면 1타3피” 추경호 “돈 보따리 가져올 것”)
item.description:
The race for Daegu mayor, the biggest battleground in the June 3 local elections, is fluctuating. In this region that has never elected a mayor from the Democratic Party, the People Power Party is hoping to "hold the fort" while the Democratic Party aims to "break in," with candidates Kim Boo-kyum (Democrat) and Choo Kyung-ho (People Power) engaged in a final all-out effort. (6·3 지방선거의 최대 격전지인 대구시장 선거 판세가 요동치고 있다. 민주당 계열 시장을 배출한 적이 없는 이 지역에서 국민의힘은 ‘수성’을, 더불어민주당은 ‘입성’을 기대하는 가운데 김부겸 민주당 후보와 추경호 국민의힘 후보가 막판 총력전을 벌이고 있다.)

On the 27th, Kim held a press briefing at his election office in Dalseo-gu, Daegu, where he brought up the "one stone, three birds" theory. He said, "If you elect Kim Boo-kyum, you can partially rein in the hardline voices within the Democratic Party. The People Power Party can be reborn as a healthy conservative force. And the struggling Daegu economy can be revived." Kim added, "The urgency Daegu citizens feel—'We need to revive the economy' and 'We must stop our sons and daughters from leaving any more'—is what is sustaining me right now. Please judge this time based on how Kim Boo-kyum can be useful." <<> On the same day, Choo visited Gwanmun Market in Nam-gu and Bangchon Market in Dong-gu, meeting with voters. During his campaign speech, Choo said, "The Democratic candidate says if you vote for him, he'll bring a bundle of money, but he'll give it to Jeolla Province first, not to Daegu. A bundle of money is something you bring through competence. I will secure the budget and revive Daegu's economy." <<> The race remains murky. Until earlier this month, Kim was leading, but as election day approached, the race turned into a tight contest within the margin of error. Recently, a poll showed Choo ahead outside the margin of error. In a survey conducted by Ace Research for Daegu MBC on the 25th-26th using wireless automated response (ARS), Kim had 45.7% and Choo had 47.1% (margin of error ±3.1 percentage points). A KBS-Korea Research phone interview survey from the 21st-25th (margin of error ±3.5 percentage points) showed Kim at 42% and Choo at 38%, a neck-and-neck race within the margin of error. (See the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website for details.) <<> Both campaigns are wary of placing too much significance on poll results. A Democratic Party lawmaker assisting with elections in the Yeongnam region told The Hankyoreh, "This is the result of solidarity and organization among People Power Party members." Joo Ho-young, the People Power Party's general election campaign chair for Daegu, said, "In the ARS survey, Choo is ahead, and in the phone interview survey, Kim is ahead. The key is how many supporters actually turn out to vote." Kim's campaign is hoping for "shy Kim Boo-kyum" voters who do not openly express their support. <<> On the streets, public sentiment seems to pit "Kim Boo-kyum's character" against "judgment on the Democratic Party." Citizens met on the 27th at Seomun Market and Dongseongno Rodeo Street in Jung-gu, Daegu, showed mixed feelings. Yang (56, surname), who runs a rice cake shop at Seomun Market, said, "It seems like more people than before are undecided. Kim Boo-kyum is decent as a person, but I don't like his party. I'm not actively supporting the People Power Party either, so I'll have to think it through until the end." Kim (54, surname), a resident of Dalseong-gun, said, "I don't think the Democratic Party's 'legislative rampage' is right, but it's not clear what Choo Kyung-ho actually intends to do." <<> Daegu/Reporters Kim Chae-un cwk@hani.co.kr, Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr, and Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr ( 김 후보는 27일 대구 달서구 선거사무소에서 연 출입기자 간담회에서 “1타3피론”을 꺼내 들었다. 그는 “김부겸을 뽑으면 민주당 내 강경한 목소리를 일부 제어할 수 있다. 국민의힘이 건강한 보수로 다시 태어날 수 있다. 어려운 대구 경제를 살릴 수 있다”고 말했다. 김 후보는 “대구 시민들이 갖고 있는 ‘경제 살려야 할 텐데’라는 그 절박성, 우리 아들딸 더 이상 떠나지 않게 해야 된다는 절박성이 저를 지금 지탱해주고 있다고 본다”며 “이번에는 김부겸 쓰임새를 보고 판단해주시라”라고 했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae: "Kim Yong-nam–Cho Kuk Unification Now Practically Difficult" (정청래 “김용남·조국 단일화 현실적으로 어렵게 돼”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 28th regarding a possible unification between Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party candidate, and Cho Kuk, the candidate from the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, in the June 3 by-election for Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul's National Assembly seat, "It has become practically difficult." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 28일 6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 김용남 민주당 후보와 조국 조국혁신당 후보의 단일화에 대해 “현실적으로 어렵게 됐다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on the YouTube channel "Kim Eo-jun's Humility is Tough News Factory" that day, the leader stated, "I received reports that the secretaries-general of both parties met yesterday (the 27th), but rather than it being a failure, there was essentially no discussion at all." He added, "Candidate Kim has been registered (with the election commission) as a candidate with the party leader's official seal, and I hope he actively addresses the allegations raised against him and navigates through them well." He urged, "Our party members are divided between those who want to protect Kim Yong-nam and those who don't, but I ask for your active participation in the campaign." (정 대표는 이날 유튜브 채널 ‘김어준의 겸손은힘들다 뉴스공장’에 출연해 “어제(27일) 양당 사무총장들이 만났는데, 무산이라기보다는 논의 자체가 없었다고 볼 정도라고 보고 받았다”며 이렇게 말했다. 그는 “김 후보는 당대표 직인이 찍힌 공천 후보자로 (선관위) 등록을 했고, 제기되는 의혹에 대해 본인이 적극 해명하고 잘 헤쳐나갔으면 좋겠다”며 “당원들도 김용남을 지키자는 분들과 그렇지 않은 분들로 나뉘어져 있는데, 선거운동에 적극적으로 참여해주십사 부탁드린다”고 했다.)

However, when asked about a scenario where "Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of the Liberty and Innovation Party, steps down, leading to unification around Yoo Eui-dong, the People Power Party candidate," Chung left room for possibility, saying, "If such a situation arises, I think we would need to put our heads together and deliberate again." (다만, 정 대표는 ‘황교안 자유와혁신 대표가 사퇴해 유의동 국민의힘 후보로 단일화 될 경우’를 묻자 “그런 상황이 되면 또다시 저희가 머리를 맞대고 숙고해봐야 하지 않을까 생각한다”고 여지를 남겼다.)

A key Democratic Party official said in a phone call with *The Hankyoreh* that day, "The Innovation Party is unilaterally pressuring for (Kim's) withdrawal, which is not something we can accept," adding, "Under the current circumstances, a unification primary is physically impossible." (민주당 핵심 관계자는 이날 한겨레와 한 통화에서 “혁신당 쪽은 일방적으로 (김 후보의) 사퇴를 압박하는데, 그건 우리가 수용할 수 있는 게 아니다”라며 “지금 상황에서 단일화 경선은 물리적으로 불가능하다”고 말했다.)

item.title: North Korea: "Denuclearization Absolutely, Forever Nonexistent"… Rejects Quad Security Consultation Body Statement (북한 “비핵화는 절대로, 영원히 없다”…쿼드 안보협의체 성명에 반발)
item.description:
North Korea has responded to the security consultation body "Quad," comprising the United States, Japan, Australia, and India, which emphasized its commitment to North Korea's denuclearization, stating, "To be clear once again, the 'denuclearization' of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (North Korea) will absolutely never happen, forever." (북한이 미국·일본·오스트레일리아·인도의 안보협의체 ‘쿼드’(Quad)가 북한 비핵화 의지를 강조한 데 대해 “다시금 명백히 하지만 조선민주주의인민공화국(북한)의 ‘비핵화’는 절대로, 영원히 없을 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

A spokesperson for North Korea's Foreign Ministry said on the 28th via the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA), "The fact that the Quad member states, led by the US, brought up our state's legitimate sovereign rights and talked about 'denuclearization' proves that Quad is merely a political and diplomatic tool serving the realization of the US's unilateral global domination strategy." (북한 외무성 대변인은 28일 조선중앙통신에 “미국을 위시한 쿼드 참가국들이 우리 국가의 합법적인 주권적 권리행사를 걸고 들면서 ‘비핵화’를 운운한 것은 쿼드가 미국의 일극 지배 전략 실현에 복무하는 정치외교적 도구에 불과하다는 것을 입증한다”며 이같이 말했다.)

On the 26th, Quad held a meeting in New Delhi, India, and issued a joint statement condemning North Korea's illegal ballistic missile, weapons of mass destruction development, and cyber activities. In the statement, they stated, "We reaffirm our commitment to the complete denuclearization of North Korea." (지난 26일 쿼드는 인도 뉴델리에서 회의를 하고 공동성명을 내어 북한의 불법 탄도미사일·대량살상무기 개발과 사이버 활동을 규탄했다. 이들은 성명에서 “북한의 완전한 비핵화에 대한 우리의 의지를 재확인한다”고 밝혔다.)

The North Korean Foreign Ministry objected, saying, "The 'joint statement' issued from this Quad foreign ministers' meeting not only severely distorts the immediate and urgent challenges and threats facing countries in the Asia-Pacific region but also blatantly exposes hostile intentions targeting specific nations without filter." (북한 외무성은 “이번에 발표된 쿼드 외무상 회의 ‘공동성명’은 아시아·태평양 지역 나라들이 직면한 당면하고 시급한 도전과 위협을 심히 왜곡하였을 뿐 아니라 특정 국가들을 겨냥한 적대적 의사를 여과 없이 노출시켰다”고 반발했다.)

The ministry also criticized Quad for expressing strong concerns over the situation in the East China Sea and South China Sea regarding the territorial disputes in the South China Sea, and for issuing messages to contain China. The ministry claimed that such a statement "is aimed at providing justification for Japan's rearmament activities and Australia's acquisition of nuclear submarines, which are causing concern in the international community." (외무성은 쿼드가 남중국해 영유권 분쟁과 관련해 동중국해 및 남중국해 정세에 강한 우려를 표하고, 중국 견제 메시지를 내놓은 것도 비판했다. 외무성은 이런 성명이 “국제사회의 우려를 불러일으키고 있는 일본의 재무장화 책동과 오스트레일리아의 핵잠수함 보유에 정당성을 부여하기 위한데 목적을 둔 것”이라고 했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac to Discuss Energy and Supply Chain Cooperation in Kazakhstan (위성락 안보실장, 카자흐스탄서 ‘에너지·공급망 협력’ 논의한다)
item.description:
Wi Sung-lac, Director of the National Security Office at the presidential office, will visit Kazakhstan ahead of the Korea-Central Asia Summit scheduled for September. (위성락 청와대 국가안보실장이 오는 9월 열리는 한-중앙아시아 정상회의를 앞두고 카자흐스탄을 방문한다.)

The presidential office announced on the 28th, "Director Wi will visit Kazakhstan, the largest trading and investment partner in Central Asia and one of the key cooperating countries for Korea-Central Asia partnership, to discuss pending issues ahead of the Korea-Central Asia Summit in September." Director Wi plans to meet with officials from the Kazakh presidential office to deliberate on matters such as △regional situation and energy-supply chain cooperation, △preparations for the Korea-Central Asia Summit, and △President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev's visit to South Korea. (청와대는 28일 “위 실장이 오는 9월 한-중앙아시아 정상회의를 앞두고 중앙아시아 내 최대 교역·투자 상대국이자 한-중앙아시아 협력의 핵심 협력국의 하나인 카자흐스탄과 현안 협의를 위해 방문할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 위 실장은 카자흐스탄 대통령실 관계자들과 만나 △역내정세 및 에너지·공급망 협력 △한-중앙아시아 정상회의 준비 △카심조마르트 토카예프 대통령 방한 등의 사안을 논의할 예정이다.)

The presidential office added, "The government plans to communicate closely with Central Asian countries, including Kazakhstan, to ensure the successful hosting of the Korea-Central Asia Summit." (청와대는 “우리 정부는 한-중앙아시아 정상회의의 성공적 개최를 위해 카자흐스탄을 포함한 중앙아시아 국가들과 긴밀히 소통해 나갈 계획”이라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: Park Ji-won: Targeting Park Geun-hye and MB, "Squid and Goby... Yoon Seok-youl Might Join Them" (박지원, 박근혜·MB 겨냥 “꼴뚜기·망둥이…윤석열도 함께 뛸라”)
item.description:
Park Ji-won, a lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, took a jab at former Presidents Lee Myung-bak and Park Geun-hye, who have been campaigning for the People Power Party candidates in the June 3 local elections, saying, "Squid and goby are all running across every corner of South Korea," and added, "At this rate, it looks like we'll see a world where Yoon Seok-youl from prison also joins the race." (박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 6·3 지방선거 국민의힘 후보 지원 유세에 나선 이명박·박근혜 전 대통령을 겨냥해 “꼴뚜기 망둥이 다 대한민국 방방곡곡을 뛴다”며 “이러다 감옥의 윤석열도 함께 뛰는 세상이 될 것 같다”고 꼬집었다.)

On the 27th, Rep. Park said on Facebook, "Following Park Geun-hye's aggressive moves, is MB heading to Busan too?" He added, "Is this the proper conduct for two people—one impeached and removed from office, and the other who should be in prison for corruption and abuse of power?" He continued, "The people are afraid. We must stay sharp and judge them." (박 의원은 27일 페이스북에서 “박근혜의 광폭 행보에 이어 MB도 부산행?”이라며 이같이 말했다. 박 의원은 “탄핵으로 파면된 전직 대통령, 국정농단과 비리로 감옥에 있어야 할 두 사람이 할 짓인가”라며 “국민이 무섭다. 정신 바짝 차리고 심판해야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

This criticism was aimed at both former President Park, who was removed from office and convicted to 22 years in prison, a 180 billion won fine, and a 3.5 billion won forfeiture for charges including allowing a confidante to meddle in state affairs and receiving special activity funds from the National Intelligence Service, and former President Lee, who was convicted to 17 years in prison, a 2 billion won fine, and a 5.78 billion won forfeiture for embezzling company funds from auto parts maker DAS and receiving bribes and US litigation costs from Samsung Group. Former President Park was granted a special pardon by former President Moon Jae-in in December 2021, and former President Lee by former President Yoon Seok-youl in December 2022. (대통령직에서 파면당한 뒤 비선 실세 국정농단 사건과 국가정보원 특수활동비 상납 등의 혐의로 징역 22년과 벌금 180억원, 추징금 35억원이 확정됐던 박 전 대통령과 자동차 부품업체 ‘다스’의 회삿돈을 횡령하고 삼성그룹으로부터 미국 소송비와 뇌물을 받은 혐의로 징역 17년과 벌금 20억원, 추징금 57억8000만원이 확정됐던 이 전 대통령을 묶어서 비판한 것이다. 박 전 대통령은 2021년 12월 문재인 전 대통령에 의해, 이 전 대통령은 2022년 12월 윤 전 대통령에 의해 특별사면됐다.)

Former President Park is fulfilling a schedule equivalent to a 'election committee chairperson' for the People Power Party. After visiting Daegu on the 23rd, and Chungcheong and Daejeon on the 25th, she visited Yeongnam regions including Jinju, Ulsan, and Busan on the 27th. She is scheduled to visit Gangwon on the 28th. Former President Lee Myung-bak also met with People Power Party Seoul mayoral candidate Oh Se-hoon on the 15th. (박 전 대통령은 국민의힘 ‘선거대책위원장급’ 일정을 소화하고 있다. 23일 대구, 25일 충청과 대전을 방문한 데 이어 27일에는 경남 진주와 울산, 부산 등 영남을 찾았다. 28일에는 강원을 찾을 예정이다. 이명박 전 대통령도 지난 15일 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보를 만난 바 있다.)

Within the 'Yoon Again' faction, there is a growing desire for former President Yoon's return. On the 27th, far-right YouTuber Ko Seong-guk appeared on lawyer Kang Yong-seok's YouTube broadcast and said, "There's one more card left for the free conservative camp," adding, "A message from President Yoon Seok-youl in prison will come out, it must come out, that's what I think." Ko also said, "I believe President Yoon will ultimately issue a message from prison saying, 'Let's go together, we need to unite as a single front.' And it's only right that he does so." (‘윤 어게인’ 세력에서는 윤 전 대통령 등판을 바라는 분위기다. 극우 유튜버 고성국씨는 27일 강용석 변호사의 유튜브 방송에 출연해 “자유우파 진영에 카드가 하나 더 남아 있다”며 “윤석열 대통령의 옥중 메시지가 나온다, 나와야 된다, 그렇게 생각한다”고 말했다. 고씨는 “윤 대통령이 옥중 메시지로 최종적으로는 ‘함께 가자, 단일 대오로 가야 된다’, 이런 메시지를 낼 것이라고 본다. 그리고 내야 마땅한다고 생각한다”고도 했다.)

Ko further stated, "The significance of former President Park Geun-hye's campaigning is that it ultimately unites the free conservative camp, which was scattered and in a state of loss. If President Yoon's message from prison comes out, it will also target not the left or centrist citizens, but our free conservative citizens," adding, "If the free conservative citizens build a united front like that and all go out to vote, the election will be unconditionally won." (고씨는 “박근혜 대통령의 유세가 굉장히 의미 있는 것은 결국 흩어졌던, 그리고 상실감에 빠졌던 자유우파를 결속시키는 거 아닌가. 윤 대통령의 옥중 메시지가 나온다면 그것 또한 타깃은 좌파나 중도 국민이 아니라 우리 자유우파 국민”이라며 “자유우파 국민들이 그런 식으로 단일 대오를 구축하고 다들 투표장에 나가면 선거는 무조건 이긴다”고 말하기도 했다.)

Jeon Gwang-jun reporter light@hani.co.kr (전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party: "TK Advantage... Seoul, Gangwon, Daejeon, South Chungcheong, Busan-Ulsan-Gyeongnam Competitive" (국힘 “TK 우세…서울·강원·대전·충남·부울경 경합”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) has assessed the situation for the June 3 local elections, identifying Daegu and North Gyeongsang as advantageous regions, while deeming Seoul, Gangwon, Daejeon, South Chungcheong, Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang as battleground regions. (국민의힘은 6·3 지방선거 판세와 관련해 대구·경북을 우세지역으로, 서울·강원·대전·충남·부산·울산·경남을 경합 지역으로 판단하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

Jung Hee-yong, head of the PPP's election campaign headquarters, held a press briefing at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, on the morning of the 28th, a day before early voting, stating, "Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk's official election campaign, which began with campaign support rallies in Daejeon and South Chungcheong, focused on targeting public sentiment in the central region and spreading that momentum nationwide, which was a key strategy in the early and mid-stages of the election." Jung added, "We analyze that the passionate campaigning by candidates, combined with recent support from former President Park Geun-hye, has consolidated the support base, leading to tight races in many areas." The remaining regions not mentioned (Gyeonggi, Incheon, North Chungcheong, Sejong, North Jeolla, South Jeolla-Gwangju, Jeju) appear to be assessed as disadvantageous. <<> Regarding the parliamentary by-elections, Jung stated that Dalseong in Daegu is considered an advantageous region, while Ulsan's Nam-gu Gap and Gongju, Buyeo, and Cheongyang in South Chungcheong are viewed as competitive but advantageous regions. (정희용 국민의힘 선거대책본부장은 사전 투표를 하루 앞둔 28일 오전 서울 여의도 당사에서 기자간담회를 열어 “대전·충남 지원 유세로 시작된 장동혁 대표의 공식 선거운동은 중원을 중심으로 민심을 공략하고 그 흐름을 전국적으로 확산시키고자 했던 선거 초중반 전략이 주요했다”며 이렇게 말했다. 정 본부장은 “후보들의 열정적인 선거 운동과 최근 박근혜 전 대통령님의 지원이 더해져 지지층이 결집하면서 곳곳에서 초접전 양상이 나타나는 것으로 분석하고 있다”고 했다. 언급하지 않은 나머지(경기·인천·충북·세종·전북·전남광주·제주) 지역은 열세 지역으로 판단하는 것으로 보인다.)

Additionally, regarding the possibility of a candidate unification in Busan's Buk-gu Gap, a parliamentary by-election district, between PPP candidate Park Min-sik and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon, Jung drew a line, saying, "Since Candidate Park Min-sik has clearly stated his position on unification, the central party respects the candidate's stance." On questions about the electoral situation in this region, he said, "Yesterday, former President Park visited Busan and earnestly appealed to give Candidate Park Min-sik a chance to work," adding, "I believe that yesterday's event has quickly laid the groundwork for closing the gap, and if we continue campaigning with local election candidates until the end, we think we can achieve meaningful results." (국회의원 재보궐선거와 관련해서는 대구 달성을 우세 지역으로, 울산 남갑과 충남 공주·부여·청양을 경합 우세 지역으로 판단했다고 정 본부장은 밝혔다.)

The PPP also encouraged participation in early voting. Jung said, "We will thoroughly monitor and inspect the entire process of early voting to ensure there are no concerns," and urged, "Please cast your valuable vote for the PPP candidates with confidence." The leadership decided to split between regular voting and early voting, but Chairman Jang chose to participate in regular voting. Previously, in March of last year, Jang proposed a bill to amend the Public Official Election Act, which aimed to abolish the early voting system. (또 국회의원 보궐선거 지역구인 부산 북갑에서 박민식 국민의힘 후보와 한동훈 무소속 후보 사이 단일화 가능성에 대해서는 “박민식 후보께서 단일화 관련해서 입장을 분명하게 밝히기 때문에 중앙당에선 당 후보 입장을 존중한다”고 선을 그었다. 그는 이 지역 판세에 대한 질문에는 “어제 박 전 대통령이 부산을 방문해 박민식 후보에게 일할 기회를 달라고 간곡히 호소했다”며 “어제를 계기로 빠르게 추격 발판이 마련될 것으로 생각하고 끝까지 지방선거 후보들과 함께 선거운동을 진행하면 유의미한 성과를 거둘 수 있을 것으로 생각한다”고 했다.)

Jang Na-rae Reporter wing@hani.co.kr Jo Hee-yeon Reporter choh@hani.co.kr (국민의힘은 사전투표 참여도 독려했다. 정 본부장은 “사전투표 대해선 걱정하시는 일 없도록 전 과정을 꼼꼼히 살피고 점검하겠다”며 “안심하고 국민의힘 후보에게 소중한 한 표를 보내달라”고 했다. 지도부는 본투표와 사전투표를 나눠서 하기로 했으나, 장 대표는 본투표에 참여하기로 했다. 앞서 장 대표는 지난해 3월 사전투표제 폐지를 골자로 한 공직선거법 개정안을 대표 발의했다.)

item.title: Outgoing National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik: "Best achievement was lifting martial law, regret not achieving constitutional amendment" (‘퇴임’ 우원식 국회의장 “가장 잘한 건 계엄 해제, 개헌 못 이뤄 아쉬워”)
item.description:
National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, one day before his retirement on the 28th, cited "lifting the emergency martial law" as his best achievement over the past two years, and "constitutional amendment" as his biggest regret for not being accomplished. He remained tight-lipped about the speculation of running for party leader at the August party convention after returning to the Democratic Party. (우원식 국회의장이 퇴임을 하루 앞둔 28일 지난 2년 동안 가장 잘한 일로 “비상계엄 해제”를, 이루지 못해 가장 아쉬운 일로는 “개헌”을 꼽았다. 더불어민주당 복당 뒤 8월 전당대회 당대표 출마설에 대해서는 말을 아꼈다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly on this day, one day before stepping down as the speaker for the first half of the 22nd National Assembly, Woo cited "protecting democracy and restoring the constitutional order in the face of the December 3 emergency martial law" as his primary accomplishment during his term. He said, "In a time of national crisis, the National Assembly led the restoration of constitutional order, and trust in the National Assembly has increased both domestically and internationally. It was a meaningful change in the history of the National Assembly and a great source of pride for me." (우 의장은 22대 국회 전반기 국회의장 퇴임을 하루 앞둔 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 임기 첫번째 성과로 “12·3 비상계엄에 맞서 민주주의를 수호하고 헌정 질서를 회복한 것”을 꼽았다. 그는 “국가적 위기 상황에서 국회가 헌정 질서 회복을 주도했고 대내외적으로 국회에 대한 신뢰도가 높아졌다. 국회 역사에서도 의미 있는 변화였고 저로서도 큰 보람이었다”고 했다.)

Woo stated, "Not only the lifting of martial law but also the subsequent early presidential election was very challenging. With many unprecedented events, we faced gaps in constitutional interpretation every time and dealt with them through a process of careful and intense judgment." He added, "It was later confirmed through the Constitutional Court's decisions that our judgments were largely flawless and correct. That is a satisfying point." As an example, he cited the "impeachment quorum controversy" during the impeachment of Acting President and Prime Minister Han Duck-soo. Regarding the dispute over whether the quorum for impeaching the acting president should be 200 seats (the quorum for impeaching a president) or 151 seats (the quorum for impeaching a prime minister), he explained, "We interpreted this as not impeaching the function but the position. Acting President Han is a prime minister performing the duties of the president. Thus, it is the general quorum (151 seats). This was an interpretation not explicitly stated in the constitution." <<> As his biggest regret during his term, he cited "failing to amend the constitution to fundamentally prevent the National Assembly from blocking illegal emergency martial law." He said, "If the second half of the National Assembly cannot achieve a constitutional amendment, it will be a huge regret in my life." He added, "We revised the National Referendum Act to remove procedural obstacles, and public consensus for a step-by-step constitutional amendment has widened. I hope the second half of the National Assembly will form a special committee on constitutional amendment and see results." <<> Woo was cautious about his plans after retirement. Regarding rumors of being appointed as Prime Minister, he indirectly denied it by saying, "Serving as National Assembly Speaker made me love the Assembly even more." However, on the speculation of running for party leader at the Democratic Party's convention in August, he did not give a clear stance, only saying, "I will do my best for the democracy of our country and the socially disadvantaged." Asked whether he would support the June 3 local elections after returning to the Democratic Party, he replied, "I will play the role needed as a party member." <<> According to the National Assembly Act, Woo, currently an independent, will step down as speaker at midnight on the 29th and return to the Democratic Party. To Cho Jung-sik, the Democratic Party's candidate for speaker of the second half of the 22nd National Assembly, who will be elected at a plenary session on the 5th of next month, he advised, "You must not make partisan choices. You should think about what benefits the people and democracy." He added, "I hope you will devise better ways to handle livelihood-related bills. Please continue the National Assembly's social dialogue body well." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (우 의장은 “계엄 해제뿐 아니라 그 후 조기 대선까지가 아주 험난했다. 전례 없는 일들이 많다 보니 헌법 해석의 공백에 부닥칠 때마다 신중하고 치열한 판단의 과정을 거쳐 대처했다”며 “대체로 큰 흠결 없이 틀리지 않은 판단을 했다는 게 이후 헌법재판 결과를 통해서도 확인됐다. 뿌듯한 점”이라고 말했다. 그 예시로는 한덕수 전 대통령 권한대행 겸 국무총리 탄핵 때의 ‘탄핵 정족수 논쟁’을 들었다. 대통령 권한대행의 탄핵 의결 정족수를 대통령 탄핵 정족수인 200석으로 할지, 국무총리 탄핵 정족수인 151석으로 할 건지 논란이 있던 상황에서 “‘이건 직무를 탄핵하는 게 아니라 직위를 탄핵하는 거다. 한 권한대행은 대통령 권한을 대행하는 직무를 하는 국무총리다. 그렇기에 일반 의결 정족수(151석)다’ 이렇게 헌법에 나와 있지 않은 해석을 우리가 했다”는 것이다.)

item.title: Minister Cho Requests Singapore's Foreign Minister, Who Visited North Korea, to "Pay Attention to Conditions for Dialogue" (조현 장관, 북 다녀온 싱가포르 외교장관에 “대화 여건 관심 당부”)
item.description:
Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul met with Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan on the 28th and asked for attention and support in creating conditions for dialogue with North Korea. (조현 외교부 장관은 28일 비비안 발라크리쉬난 싱가포르 외교장관과 회담에서 북한과의 대화 여건을 조성하는 데 관심과 지원을 당부했다.)

Minister Balakrishnan is visiting South Korea after stops in China and North Korea, and met with North Korean Foreign Minister Choe Son-hui in Pyongyang on the 26th. Minister Cho listened to Minister Balakrishnan's impressions of his North Korea visit and requested attention and support from Singapore and the ASEAN level in fostering conditions for dialogue with North Korea. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs reported that Minister Balakrishnan expressed sympathy and responded by saying the two sides should communicate closely for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. ( 발라크리쉬난 장관은 중국, 북한을 거쳐 한국을 방문 중이며, 지난 26일 평양에서 최선희 북한 외무상과 회담했다. 조 장관은 발라크리쉬난 장관의 방북 소감을 듣고 북한과의 대화 여건을 조성하는 데 싱가포르를 비롯한 아세안(ASEAN) 차원의 관심과 지원을 당부했다. 발라크리쉬난 장관은 공감을 표하고 한반도 평화와 안정을 위해 양측이 긴밀히 소통해 나가자고 답했다고 외교부가 전했다.)

The two ministers exchanged opinions on key bilateral issues, the region, and international developments of mutual concern. Minister Cho welcomed Minister Balakrishnan's first official bilateral visit to South Korea since taking office in 2015 and assessed that the strategic partnership between the two countries is deepening through active high-level exchanges, including President Lee Jae-myung's reciprocal visit four months after Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong's official visit to South Korea in November last year. Minister Balakrishnan emphasized that South Korea and Singapore are friendly nations sharing core values such as free trade and multilateralism, and expressed hope for expanding and deepening mutually beneficial cooperation in various fields, including trade, investment, high-tech, and new growth sectors. ( 두 장관은 양국 주요 현안과 지역, 국제정세 등 공동 관심사에 대해 의견을 교환했다. 조 장관은 발라크리쉬난 장관이 2015년 취임 이후 양자 차원의 첫 공식 방한을 한 것을 환영하고, 지난해 11월 싱가포르 로렌스 웡 총리의 공식방한에 이어 4개월 만에 이재명 대통령의 답방이 이루어지는 등 활발한 고위급 교류를 통해 양국 간 전략적 동반자 관계가 한층 심화되고 있다고 평가했다. 발라크리쉬난 장관은 한국과 싱가포르가 자유무역과 다자주의 등 핵심 가치를 공유하는 우방국임을 강조하면서, 교역·투자 및 첨단·신성장 등 다양한 분야에서 양국 간 호혜적 협력을 더욱 확대, 심화해 나가기를 기대한다고 말했다.)

The two ministers shared assessments of the recent situation in the Middle East and agreed that peace in the region and the freedom and security of navigation in international waterways, including the Strait of Hormuz, are crucial to the security and economy of both countries, which are trading nations. They decided to continue close communication and cooperation on this matter. ( 양국 장관은 최근 중동 정세에 관한 평가를 공유하고, 중동 지역의 평화와 호르무즈 해협 등 국제 통항로의 자유로운 항행과 안전 보장이 통상 국가인 양국의 안보와 경제에도 매우 중요하다는 점에 공감하면서, 이와 관련하여 양국간 긴밀한 소통과 협력을 지속해 나가기로 했다.)

Minister Balakrishnan is also scheduled to meet with Unification Minister Kim Young-ho on the same day to discuss the situation on the Korean Peninsula. Singapore, which emphasizes a neutral diplomatic stance, maintains smooth diplomatic relations with both South and North Korea and played a mediating role by providing the venue for the first North Korea-U.S. summit in June 2018 between then-U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean Chairman Kim Jong-un. ( 발라크리쉬난 장관은 이날 정동영 통일부 장관과도 만나 한반도 정세 등을 논의한다. 중립적 외교 기조를 강조하는 싱가포르는 남북한 모두와 원만한 외교 관계를 유지하고 있고, 2018년 6월 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 1차 북미 정상회담을 할 때 장소를 제공하는 등 중재 역할을 했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr ( 박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: On Seosomun Overpass Collapse and GTX Rebar Omission, "Responsibilities Must Be Strictly Enforced" (이 대통령, 서소문 고가 붕괴·GTX 철근 누락에 “책임 엄정히 물어야”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 28th, referring to the recent collapse of the Seosomun overpass demolition site and the case of omitted rebar in the GTX-A Samsung Station, "Relevant authorities must swiftly get to the bottom of these matters, and based on the results, strictly hold accountable those responsible, regardless of their position." (이재명 대통령이 28일 최근 발생한 서소문 고가차도 철거 현장 붕괴 사고, 수도권광역급행철도(GTX)-에이(A) 삼성역 철근 누락 사태 등을 거론하며 “관계기관이 신속하게 진상 규명하고, 그 결과에 따라 지위고하를 막론하고 엄정하게 책임을 물어야 한다”고 말했다.)

At a senior secretary meeting held at the Blue House, President Lee said, "In corners of our society, there still persists a bad practice of prioritizing money over safety and efficiency over safety." He added, "The collapse at the Seosomun overpass demolition site the day before yesterday, and the rebar omission issue at Samsung Station for the GTX—these may stem from such ills, and a thorough investigation is necessary." <<> "These cases are particularly serious because they involve the public sector, which above all should be leading in ensuring public safety," President Lee continued. "Money cannot be more precious than lives. We must remember that safety is the most efficient investment." <<> President Lee also noted that today marks the 10th anniversary of the Guro Station disaster. "Today marks the 10th anniversary of the Guro Station disaster, where a young worker working alone on the platform was struck and killed by a train," he said. "Thanks to public attention and on-site efforts, industrial accident fatalities have significantly decreased in the first quarter of this year, but many deaths are still occurring." <<> Seo Young-ji, reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “우리 사회 일각에서는 안전보다 돈, 안전보다는 효율을 중시하는 그런 못된 관행이 여전하다”며 “그저께 발생한 서소문 고가차도 철거 현장 사고, 삼성역 수도권광역급행철도 철근 누락 문제 역시 이러한 병폐에서 비롯된 것 아닌지 철저한 조사가 필요하다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Local election early voting rate: 20% → 21% → what about this time?… Ruling and opposition parties urge voter base consolidation (지방선거 사전투표율 20%→21%→이번엔?…여야, 지지층 결집 호소)
item.description:
Early voting for the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections will take place over two days starting on the 29th. Both the ruling and opposition parties are encouraging early voting and rallying their support bases. (6·3 지방선거와 국회의원 재보궐선거 사전투표가 29일부터 이틀간 실시된다. 여야 모두 사전투표를 독려하며 지지층 결집에 나섰다.)

Cho Seung-rae, Secretary-General of the Democratic Party of Korea, said at a press briefing on the 28th, “Early voting begins tomorrow. Representative Chung Cheong-rae is encouraging voting through media appearances, briefings, and campaign rallies in Seoul.” Representative Chung said at rallies in Gangdong, Gwangjin, and Mapo in Seoul, “They say the conservatives are consolidating, so we must unite even more tightly,” adding, “There is only one secret to winning this election. Please choose a Democratic Party candidate who will work in sync with President Lee Jae-myung to ensure stable state affairs.” <<> Jeong Hee-yong, Secretary-General of the People Power Party, also stated at a press briefing, “The passionate campaigning by our candidates, combined with former President Park Geun-hye’s support, has consolidated our support base, leading to close contests in many areas,” and added, “We will carefully monitor early voting to ensure there are no concerns. Please confidently cast your vote for the People Power Party candidate.” He said, “Citizens who believe the arrogance of the Lee Jae-myung administration must be judged will go to the polls,” and noted, “A high early voting rate is always advantageous.” <<> In recent local elections, the early voting rate has been just over 20%. In 2018, when the Democratic Party won by a landslide, it was 20.14%, and four years ago, when the People Power Party won by a landslide, it was 20.62%. The overall voter turnout dropped sharply from 60.2% in 2018 to 50.9% in 2022, but the early voting rate remained similar. <<> Early voting rates in local elections are generally lower compared to presidential or general elections. In the 2022 presidential election, where Yoon Suk Yeol and Lee Jae-myung fiercely competed, the early voting rate hit a record high of 36.93%, while in the 2024 presidential election it was tallied at 34.74%. In the 2020 and 2024 general elections, the rates were 26.69% and 31.28%, respectively. <<> This June 3 election, held a year after the early presidential election triggered by the martial law crisis and impeachment, resembles the situation of the 2018 local elections. Additionally, National Assembly by-elections in 14 districts, described as a “mini general election,” are expected to impact the early voting rate. <<> During the two days of early voting, voters can cast their ballots at any early voting station nationwide, regardless of their registered address, from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. The locations of polling stations can be checked on the website of the National Election Commission and on portal sites. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr ( 조승래 더불어민주당 사무총장은 28일 기자간담회에서 “내일부터 사전투표가 시작된다. 정청래 대표가 미디어 출연과 간담회, 서울 유세 등을 통해 투표를 독려하고 있다”고 말했다. 정 대표는 이날 서울 강동·광진·마포 유세에서 “보수가 결집한다는데 우리는 더 똘똘 뭉쳐야 한다”며 “이번 선거의 승리 비법은 딱 한 가지다. 이재명 대통령이 국정을 안정적으로 이끌 수 있도록 대통령과 손발 맞춰 일할 민주당 후보를 뽑아달라”고 말했다. )

item.title: President Lee: "I Like Eating at Markets" – Dismisses Claims of 'Election Interference' (이 대통령 “시장에서 밥 먹는 것 좋아해”…‘선거개입’ 주장 일축)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 28th dismissed the opposition party's claims of 'election interference,' saying, "I've always liked eating at markets, so I hope you'll understand." (이재명 대통령이 28일 “원래 저는 시장에서 밥 먹는 걸 좋아하니 이해하길 바란다”라며 야당의 ‘선거개입’ 주장을 일축했다.)

During a meeting with senior secretaries held at the Presidential Office (Cheong Wa Dae) that day, President Lee stated, "Some people claim that I often eat at markets after recent events, questioning why I go to markets to eat." President Lee has been visiting markets after regional schedules lately, which the People Power Party has criticized as "interference in local elections." On the 27th, President Lee visited the Nambang Market in Yeongdo-gu, Busan, following the '31st Sea Day Ceremony,' and on the 26th, he also visited Jagalchi Market in Jung-gu, Busan, for dinner. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “제가 최근에 행사 끝나고 주로 식사를 시장에서 하는데 왜 시장에 밥 먹으러 갔느냐 이렇게 주장하는 사람도 있다”면서 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 최근 지역 일정을 소화한 뒤 시장을 방문하고 있는데, 국민의힘은 이를 “지방선거 개입”이라고 비판하고 있다. 이 대통령은 지난 27일 부산 영도구에서 열린 ‘제31회 바다의 날 기념식’에 참석한 뒤 같은 지역 남항시장을 방문했고, 26일에도 부산 중구 자갈치시장을 찾아 저녁 식사를 했다.)

President Lee added, "When I go to markets, I hear stories from many people, and it seems the situation in traditional markets hasn't improved as expected but rather worsened." He called for expanded government support for the modernization of traditional markets and the maintenance of aging facilities. Furthermore, he said, "It would be good to activate an online distribution platform that connects traditional markets nationwide. Many transactions are happening online, but because traditional markets are lagging behind there, they seem to struggle to diversify their sales channels and face difficulties. I ask you to find ways to boost distribution using all available means." President Lee added, "For the country to thrive, traditional markets must thrive, and the people and regions must thrive. I hope you will pay more careful attention, lower your perspective, and implement necessary policies on the ground with a sense of urgency." (이 대통령은 “시장에 가면 여러 사람 이야기를 듣는데 전통시장 상황이 생각보다 개선도 안 되고 악화되는 것 같다”며 전통시장 현대화, 노후시설 정비 등에 대한 정부 지원 확대를 주문했다. 아울러 “전국의 전통시장을 하나로 연결하는 온라인 유통 플랫폼도 활성화하면 좋겠다”며 “온라인 거래도 많은데 전통시장들이 거기서 밀리다 보니까 매출처를 다양화하지 못하고 어려움을 겪는 것 같다. 온갖 수단을 동원해서 유통이 활발해질 수 있도록 방안을 찾아주길 바란다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “전통시장이 살아야, 국민과 지방이 살아야 나라가 산다”며 “조금 더 세심하게, 좀 더 낮게, 좀 더 현장 속에서 필요한 정책들을 챙기고 속도감 있게 추진하면 좋겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "South Korea is a dagger aimed at China" Chinese Embassy to Bronson: "You crossed the line" (“한국은 중국 겨눈 단검” 브런슨에 중 대사관 “선 넘었다”)
item.description:
The Chinese Embassy in South Korea has strongly objected to U.S. Forces Korea Commander General Xavier Bronson's description of South Korea as a "dagger aimed at China," calling it a step too far. <<> The Chinese Embassy spokesperson in South Korea stated in a Q&A format response on the 29th regarding General Bronson's remarks, referencing the commander's comments and declaring, "Your remarks have clearly crossed the line." <<> General Bronson appeared on a podcast produced by the U.S. Army War College's China Landpower Studies Center (CLSC) on the 22nd, where he said, "When China looks from its eastern coast, South Korea appears like a dagger stuck in the heart of Asia." This was to emphasize the geographical location of South Korea and the importance of U.S. Forces Korea in checking China. General Bronson had previously described South Korea as a fixed aircraft carrier between China and Japan. <<> The Chinese Embassy spokesperson criticized, "Is describing the U.S. Forces Korea as an aircraft carrier or a dagger an act of belligerence, or an intention to use another country as a tool?" The spokesperson also mentioned that President Trump recently visited China, where the U.S. and Chinese leaders agreed to build a "constructive strategic stability relationship," and questioned General Bronson, "Is your hostile and aggressive rhetoric toward China authorized by the U.S. government? Or is it intended to derail the agreements reached at the U.S.-China summit?" <<> The spokesperson noted that some South Korean media outlets have also published critical commentaries on General Bronson's remarks, adding, "We hope the U.S. Forces Korea commander will respect regional countries and do more to contribute to regional peace and stability." <<> Senior Reporter Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군 사령관이 한국을 “중국을 겨눈 단검”이라고 표현한 데 대해 주한중국대사관이 “선을 넘었다”면서 강하게 반발했다.)

item.title: After Seosomun Accident… Jung Won-oh Says "Form Life Safety Committee," Oh Se-hoon Says "Will Inspect Sites" (서소문 사고 뒤…정원오 “생명안전위 구성” 오세훈 “현장 살필 것”)
item.description:
Following the collapse of the Seosomun overpass in Seoul, Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate, who had suspended their campaigns for the June 3 local elections for Seoul mayor, held press briefings on the 28th, appealing for support and early voting under the theme of "A Safe Seoul." (서울 서소문 고가차도 붕괴 사고 이후 6·3 지방선거 서울시장 선거운동을 멈췄던 정원오 더불어민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 28일 각각 기자간담회를 열어 ‘안전한 서울’을 화두로 지지와 사전투표 참여를 호소했다.)

Candidate Jung held a press briefing at his election camp in Jung-gu that day, stating, "What the mayor prioritizes determines the direction of Seoul's city administration," and pledged to form a "Life Safety Committee directly under the mayor" if elected. Jung said, "The budget for accident prevention is seven times that of post-incident recovery," adding, "Currently, Seoul's administration is focused on post-event measures, but I will boldly shift it to a prevention-oriented approach." He proposed increasing the amount spent on prevention from the current 10% to 30% of Seoul's disaster management fund, establishing a multi-layered on-site inspection system involving industrial safety task forces, special judicial police, autonomous police, and district offices, and conducting comprehensive inspections of construction sites, underground spaces, and aging infrastructure. (정 후보는 이날 중구 선거캠프에서 기자간담회를 열어 “시장이 무엇을 중요하게 보느냐가 서울시정의 우선순위를 결정한다”며 시장에 당선되면 ‘시장 직속 생명안전위원회’를 구성하겠다고 공약했다. 정 후보는 “사고 예방에 들어가는 예산은 사후 복구의 7배”라며 “현재 서울 행정은 사후 조치에 집중돼 있는데, 과감하게 예방 위주로 바꾸겠다”고 말했다. 서울시 재난관리기금에서 예방에 쓰는 금액을 현재 10%에서 30%로 늘리고 △산업안전기동대·특별사법경찰·자치경찰·자치구가 함께 움직이는 2중·3중의 현장 점검 체계 마련 △공사장·지하공간·노후기반시설 전면 점검 등을 하겠다는 것이다.)

Candidate Jung remarked, "Many safety accidents have occurred in Seoul, and numerous measures have been introduced since the Itaewon disaster, but safety incidents are still happening," adding, "When the mayor neglects safety versus making it the top priority, the mindset of public officials and even partner companies changes." He added, "Since starting the campaign, I've said that upon taking office, the first thing I'd approve would be a safety inspection of all underground structures at every construction site." (정 후보는 “(서울에서) 많은 안전사고가 났고, 이태원 참사 이후 많은 대책이 나오고 있지만, 여전히 안전사고가 발생하고 있다”며 “시장이 안전을 등한시 했을 경우와 안전을 제1원칙으로 할 경우 공직사회의 생각이 달라지고 협력업체도 달라진다”고 말했다. 그는 “선거운동을 시작할 때부터 취임하면 모든 공사장 지하구조에 대한 안전점검을 첫번째 결재로 하겠다고 말씀드렸다”고 덧붙였다.)

Candidate Oh also held a press briefing at his election camp in Jongno-gu that day, saying, "My heart hasn't been at ease for a single moment since the Seosomun accident," and, "Although I made safety the top priority of city administration, pushed through despite much opposition to achieve 100% CCTV installation at all construction sites across Seoul, I deeply realize it's still insufficient." He continued, "Seoul is larger than many European countries and is a microcosm of South Korea, where all functions of the state—economy, disaster management, transportation, housing, welfare, and culture—are concentrated," adding, "A prepared mayor is needed who can return to the site the day after the election and immediately start solving problems. I will harshly whip myself into action and ensure no small risk signal on the ground goes unnoticed." (오 후보도 이날 종로구 선거캠프에서 기자간담회를 열고 “서소문 사고 이후 마음이 한 순간도 편하지 않다”며 “안전을 시정 최우선 가치를 두고 많은 저항을 무릅쓰면서 서울 전역 공사장 시시티브이(CCTV)설치 100%를 이뤄냈지만, 아직도 부족하다는 사실을 절감한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 오 후보는 “서울은 웬만한 유럽국가보다 큰 규모이고, 경제·재난·교통·주택·복지· 문화 등 국가의 모든 기능이 집약된 대한민국의 축소판”이라며 “선거 다음날 바로 현장에 돌아가 즉시 문제 해결에 착수할 수 있는 준비된 시장이 필요하다. 스스로를 가혹하게 채찍질하고 현장의 작은 위험 신호 하나도 놓치지 않도록 살피겠다”고 말했다.)

Candidate Oh also noted, "If you visit a construction site commissioned by Seoul now, dozens of CCTVs are running. The fact that Hyundai Engineering & Construction voluntarily reported the omission of rebar at the Suseo GTX site and asked Seoul for a remediation plan was likely because these CCTVs created psychological pressure." He added, "I will stop the real estate hell and tax bombs. Please choose a candidate who has been directly verified by citizens, not one unilaterally selected by the ruling power." (오 후보는 또, “지금 서울시 발주 공사장에 가면 시시티브이가 수십개씩 돌아가고 있다. 이번 수서역 지티엑스(GTX) 현장에서 현대건설이 스스로 철근 누락을 서울시에 보고하고 보완책을 마련해달라고 한 것도 이 시시티브이가 심리적 압박이 됐을 가능성이 높다”고 했다. 그는 “부동산 지옥, 세금폭탄을 막아내겠다. 권력이 일방적으로 선택한 후보 아니라 시민이 직접 검증한 후보를 선택해달라”고 덧붙였다.)

The two candidates will hold their first and only face-to-face debate at 11 PM that night at SBS Prism Tower in Mapo-gu, Seoul, in a mayoral candidate debate. The debate will also include Kim Jeong-cheol from the Reform Party and Kwon Young-guk from the Justice Party. (두 후보는 이날 밤 11시 서울 마포구 에스비에스(SBS) 프리즘타워에서 열리는 서울시장 후보 토론회에서 처음이자 마지막 대면 토론을 한다. 이 토론회에는 김정철 개혁신당 후보, 권영국 정의당 후보도 참여한다.)

Reporters Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr and Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr 유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Hwang Kyo-ahn to Yoo Ui-dong, Who Urged Unified Candidacy: "A Political Show Deceiving Pyeongtaek Citizens" (황교안, ‘단일화 촉구’ 유의동에 “평택 시민 기만 정치쇼”)
item.description:
Hwang Kyo-ahn, candidate of the Liberty and Innovation Party for the June 3 by-election in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province, on the 28th rebutted Yoo Ui-dong, candidate of the People Power Party, who had publicly proposed a unified candidacy, saying, "Candidate Yoo took the lead in the impeachment of President Park Geun-hye. He should first apologize for his own betrayal." (6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 나선 황교안 자유와혁신 후보가 28일 단일화를 공개 제안한 유의동 국민의힘 후보를 향해 “유 후보는 박근혜 대통령 탄핵에 앞장섰다. 자신의 배신행위에 대해 먼저 사과부터 하라”고 반박했다.)

At a press conference held at his Pyeongtaek-eul campaign office, Candidate Hwang stated, "Candidate Yoo's press conference proposing a unified candidacy is nothing but a political show to build justification by deceiving the citizens of Pyeongtaek, and a strategic pressure on our camp. I deeply regret his political engineering calculation of trying to take credit for appearing to work toward unification on the surface while shifting the blame behind the scenes." He claimed, "I, Hwang Kyo-ahn, have never once refused unification for the sake of conservative victory, yet Candidate Yoo held a press conference without ever discussing unification with me, who has always kept the door open." He then called for "coming to a fair negotiation table for unification." (황 후보는 이날 평택을 선거캠프에서 기자회견을 열어 “유 후보의 단일화 제안 기자회견은 평택시민을 기만하는 명분쌓기용 정치쇼이자 우리 캠프를 향한 전략적 압박에 불과하다”며 “앞에서는 단일화 노력하는 척 생색내고 뒤에서는 책임을 떠넘기려는 정치공학적 계산에 깊은 유감을 표한다”고 말했다. 그는 “저 황교안은 단 한 번도 보수 승리를 위한 단일화를 거부한 적이 없는데, 늘 문을 열어두는 저에게 (유 후보가) 단 한 번도 단일화 얘기를 하지도 않고 기자회견을 했다”고 주장했다. 그러면서 “공정한 단일화 테이블에 나오라”고 했다.)

At the same time, Candidate Hwang criticized, "(During the debate hosted by the Pyeongtaek Election Commission the previous day) I showed Candidate Yoo the ballot paper from the fraudulent election and asked if he didn't think it was strange, but he said it wasn't. I can't understand the structure of his brain. He's someone who doesn't know even the basics." He also added, "Candidate Yoo should resign from his candidacy for the sake of the nation and Pyeongtaek." (그러면서도 황 후보는 “(전날 평택시선거관리위원회 주관 토론회에서) 유 후보에게 부정선거 투표용지를 보여주면서 이거 이상하다고 생각하지 않느냐고 물었더니 이상하지 않다고 했다”며 “뇌 구조를 이해할 수 없다. 낫 놓고 기역자도 모르는 사람”이라고 비난했다. “유 후보는 국민과 평택을 위해 후보직을 사퇴해야 한다”고도 했다.)

Earlier that day, Candidate Yoo held an emergency press conference at the party headquarters in Yeouido, urging Candidate Hwang to make a decision for unified candidacy, saying, "A vote for division only helps Kim Yong-nam (Democratic Party of Korea), the candidate with the worst morals and ideology, and Cho Kuk (Cho Kuk Innovation Party)." Candidate Yoo stated, "I met Candidate Hwang in person a few days ago, but unfortunately, I didn't receive an immediate answer at that time," and regarding Hwang's "fraud election" claims, he said, "I don't think it's a major obstacle or precondition to unification." (앞서 유 후보는 이날 여의도 당사에서 긴급 기자회견을 열어 “분열의 한 표는 도덕심도 이념도 최악인 김용남 (더불어민주당) 후보와 조국 (조국혁신당) 후보를 도울 뿐”이라며 본인으로 후보 단일화 결단을 해달라고 황 후보에게 촉구했다. 유 후보는 “며칠 전 황 후보를 직접 만났지만, 아쉽게도 그 자리에서 바로 답을 듣지 못했다”며 황 후보의 ‘부정선거론’에 대해 “(단일화에) 큰 걸림돌이나 전제가 되지는 않는다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

According to a telephone interview survey conducted by MBC-Korea Research on the 26th and 27th, with a margin of error of ±4.4% points, the approval ratings for candidates in Pyeongtaek-eul were: Kim Yong-nam 26%, Yoo Ui-dong 20%, Cho Kuk 29%, Kim Jae-yeon (Progressive Party) 2%, and Hwang Kyo-ahn 10%. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) (이날 공개된 지난 26~27일 문화방송-코리아리서치의 경기 평택을 무선 전화면접 조사(오차범위 ±4.4%포인트)에서 후보별 지지율은 김용남 26%, 유의동 20%, 조국 29%, 김재연(진보당) 후보 2%, 황교안 10%로 나타났다. (자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참고))

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Advance voting on 29-30 allows mobile IDs; screenshots prohibited (29∼30일 사전투표 ‘모바일 신분증’ 가능…캡처 불가)
item.description:
Advance voting for the June 3 local elections will take place over two days, from 29 to 30. Most voters nationwide will receive seven ballots, but voters in areas holding by-elections for National Assembly seats will receive eight ballots. (6·3 지방선거 사전투표가 29∼30일 이틀 동안 진행된다. 전국 대부분 유권자들은 7장의 투표용지를 받지만, 국회의원 재보궐선거가 열리는 지역의 유권자들은 8장의 투표용지를 받는다.)

Advance voting will be held from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. at 3,541 advance polling stations across the country. Voters can cast their ballots at any advance polling station regardless of their registered address. The locations of advance polling stations can be checked on the National Election Commission's website or through portal sites. On the main voting day, June 3, voting is only permitted at polling stations in the jurisdiction of one's registered residence. (사전투표는 전국 3541개 사전 투표소에서 아침 6시부터 저녁 6시까지 진행된다. 유권자들은 주소지와 상관없이 모든 사전투표소에서 투표할 수 있다. 사전투표소 위치는 중앙선관위 누리집이나 포털 사이트 등에서 확인하면 된다. 6월3일 본투표 때는 주민등록 주소지 관할투표소에서만 투표할 수 있다.)

When going to vote, you must bring an identification document such as a resident registration card, passport, or driver's license. Mobile IDs can be used as identification if the app is opened to verify the photo, name, and date of birth. However, screenshots of identification documents are not acceptable. (투표하러 갈 때는 주민등록증이나 여권, 운전면허증 등 신분증을 챙겨야 한다. 모바일 신분증은 사진·성명·생년월일을 확인할 수 있게 앱을 실행하면 신분증으로 사용할 수 있다. 그러나 화면을 캡처한 신분증은 사용할 수 없다.)

Most voters nationwide will receive seven ballots. Voters first receive and vote on three ballots related to elections for metropolitan mayors and governors (such as city and provincial governors), superintendents of education, and heads of basic local governments (district heads, mayors, and county chiefs). Then, they receive and vote on four more ballots related to elections for local constituency city and provincial council members, district, city, and county council members, and proportional representation city and provincial council members and district, city, and county council members. However, voters in areas holding National Assembly by-elections will receive one additional ballot, for a total of eight ballots to cast. Voters in Sejong and Jeju, which do not hold elections for basic local government heads and basic council members, will receive four ballots. (전국 대부분의 유권자는 7장의 투표용지를 받는다. 유권자들은 우선 시·도지사 등 광역단체장과 교육감, 구청장·시장·군수등 기초단체장 선거 관련 3장의 투표 용지를 맏아 투표한다. 이후 지역구 시·도의원과 구·시·군의원, 비례대표 시·도의원과 구·시·군의원 선거 관련 4장의 투표 용지를 받아 다시 투표하면 된다. 다만 국회의원 재보궐선거가 열리는 지역 유권자들은 1장의 투표용지가 추가 돼 총 8장을 받아 투표하면 된다. 기초단체장과 기초의원 선거를 치르지 않는 세종과 제주 유권자들은 4장의 투표용지를 받는다.)

The advance voting turnout for the 2022 local elections was 20.62%, and for the 2018 local elections, it was 20.14%. (2022년 지방선거 사전 투표율은 20.62%, 2018년 지방선거 사전투표율은 20.14%였다.)

item.title: Iranian Ambassador Says Will "Faithfully Report" South Korea's "HMM Nao Investigation" Results to Home Country (이란 대사, 한국 ‘나무호 조사’ 결과에 “본국에 충실히 보고할 것”)
item.description:
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 28th that Iranian Ambassador to South Korea, Saeed Koozechi, after hearing the South Korean government's investigation results stating that the HMM Nao, a South Korean vessel, was attacked by Iranian forces in the Strait of Hormuz, said he would "faithfully report" this to his home country (Iran). This statement is ongoing. (사이드 쿠제치 주한이란대사가 호르무즈해협에서 우리 선박 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호가 이란 쪽 공격을 받았다는 한국 정부 조사 결과를 듣고 “본국(이란)에 충실히 보고하겠다”고 말했다고 외교부가 28일 밝혔다. 하고 있다.)

At a regular briefing that day, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Park Il said, "Ambassador Koozechi stated that he would faithfully report our government's investigation results and our position to his home country," adding, "The government will continue to closely consult with Iran and respond accordingly." The previous day, First Vice Foreign Minister Park Yoon-joo announced at a briefing that the aircraft that struck the HMM Nao was likely an Iranian-made anti-ship missile. Shortly after the briefing, Vice Minister Park summoned Ambassador Koozechi to explain the investigation findings and demanded responsible measures and prevention of recurrence. (박일 외교부 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 “쿠제치 대사는 우리 정부의 조사 결과와 관련 우리 입장을 본국에 충실히 보고하겠다고 했다”며 “정부는 앞으로도 이란과 긴밀하게 협의하면서 대응해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 전날 박윤주 외교부 1차관은 브리핑에서 나무호를 피격한 비행체는 이란산 대함미사일일 가능성이 높다고 발표했다. 박 차관은 브리핑 직후 쿠제치 대사를 초치해 조사 내용을 설명하고, 책임있는 조처와 재발방지 등을 요구했다.)

However, after meeting with Vice Minister Park, Ambassador Koozechi denied the investigation results in a meeting with reporters, stating, "From the Iranian side, we completely deny any involvement in this matter. We were absolutely not involved." The Iranian Embassy in South Korea told The Hankyoreh that day, "The embassy has no position or comment to offer on this issue." (그러나 쿠제치 대사는 박 차관과 면담한 뒤 기자들과 만난 자리에서 “이란 쪽에서는 이 문제와 관련해 모두 부인한다. 절대로 거기에 개입된 것이 없다”며 조사 결과를 부인했다. 주한이란대사관은 이날 한겨레에 “대사관은 해당 사안에 대해 밝힐 입장이나 논평이 없다”고 했다.)

In response, a Foreign Ministry official said, "Ambassador Koozechi's main message was that he would convey to his home country our investigation results, the demand for responsible measures, and the request to ensure the safety of our vessel and crew," adding, "We will not speculate on what position the Iranian government or foreign ministry will take afterwards." (이에 대해 외교부 당국자는 “쿠제치 대사가 (말한) 주된 메시지는 우리의 조사 결과와 책임있는 조치, 또 우리 선박과 선원의 안전을 잘 챙겨달라고 한 점을 본국에 전달하겠다고 한 것”이라며 “이후 이란 정부와 외교부 차원에서 어떤 입장을 보일지는 예단하지 않겠다”고 했다.)

The official added, "Publicly announcing the investigation results to the people and explaining them to the other country (Iran) is in itself a very serious diplomatic measure." (이 당국자는 “공개적으로 국민에게 (조사 결과를) 발표하고, 상대국(이란)에 설명한 것 자체가 굉장히 엄중한 외교적 조치”라고 덧붙였다.)

There is a possibility that Ambassador Koozechi's denial of the investigation results stems from insufficient communication between the Iranian Embassy in South Korea and the Iranian government. The entire Middle East is currently in the period of the Islamic holiday 'Eid al-Adha.' The Foreign Ministry is closely monitoring the response the Iranian government will provide in the future. (주한이란대사관과 이란 정부가 충분히 소통하지 못해 쿠제치 대사가 조사 결과를 인정하지 않는 입장을 내놓았을 가능성도 있다. 현재 중동 전체는 이슬람 명절인 ‘이드 알 아드하’ 기간이다. 외교부는 이란 정부가 추후 내놓을 반응을 주시하고 있다.)

For the South Korean government, managing the aftermath that could spread to other areas, such as the safety of the 25 South Korean vessels and crew remaining in the Strait of Hormuz and energy issues, while dealing with Iran, is expected to be a challenge. (호르무즈해협에 남은 우리 선박 25척과 선원의 안전, 에너지 문제 등 다른 영역으로 퍼질 여파를 관리하면서 이란을 상대해야 하는 것이 한국 정부에겐 과제가 될 전망이다.)

During the summons of Ambassador Koozechi, Vice Minister Park also raised the issues of the safety of our vessels and crew and navigation through the Strait of Hormuz, requesting responsible cooperation. Spokesperson Park also said, "We are meticulously responding diplomatically, considering the protection of our citizens and businesses in the Middle East, the energy supply chain, South Korea-Iran bilateral relations, and the post-incident situation in the Strait of Hormuz and the Middle East." (박 차관은 쿠제치 대사를 초치한 자리에서도 우리 선박과 선원의 안전 및 호르무즈해협 통항 문제를 제기하며 책임있는 협조를 요청했다. 박 대변인은 또 “중동 내 우리 국민과 기업 보호, 에너지 공급망, 한-이란 양자 관계, 전후 호르무즈해협 및 중동 상황을 고려하면서 치밀하게 외교적 대응을 하고 있다”고 말했다.)

The Foreign Ministry has stated that, if necessary, high-level communication, such as a phone call between Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, will also be conducted. (외교부는 필요할 경우 조현 외교장관과 아바스 아라그치 이란 외무장관의 통화 등 고위급 소통도 하겠다는 입장이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Democratic Party Appeals for Unity, Warning 'President Lee Is in Big Trouble'…Park Geun-hye Goes on an Offensive in People Power Party Campaign (민주 ‘이 대통령 큰일 난다’ 결집 호소…국힘 유세에 박근혜 광폭 행보)
item.description:
On the 28th, a day before early voting for the June 3 local elections, both the ruling and opposition parties launched an all-out effort to pull their supporters to the polls. The Democratic Party of Korea urged, "Please vote for our candidates to strengthen President Lee Jae-myung," while the People Power Party appealed, "Come out to the polls to check the arrogant administration and lend strength to our candidates." (6·3 지방선거 사전투표를 하루 앞둔 28일, 여야는 지지층을 최대한 투표장으로 끌어내기 위한 총력전을 펼쳤다. 더불어민주당은 “이재명 대통령에게 힘을 실어주기 위해 민주당 후보에게 꼭 투표해달라”고, 국민의힘은 “오만한 정권 견제를 위해 투표장에 나와 국민의힘 후보들에게 힘을 보태달라”고 호소했다.)

On this day, Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae appeared on YouTube’s 'Kim Eo-jun's Humility is Hard News Factory' and said, "Isn't it clear that the other side is rallying conservatives with 'Yoon (Suk Yeol) again, Park Geun-hye (former President) again, and MB (Lee Myung-bak, former President) again?' If the election goes wrong, it will be big trouble for President Lee. Please make sure to vote for our candidates to give strength to President Lee." He also encouraged early voting, stating, "Our democratic reform and progressive camp must unite further. I ask all citizens who support President Lee to come out to the polls." As a surge in conservative voter consolidation was detected at the end of the campaign, he emphasized a 'crisis' to rally the party's base. (정청래 민주당 대표는 이날 유튜브 ‘김어준의 겸손은 힘들다 뉴스공장’에 나와 “저쪽은 윤(석열) 어게인, 박근혜 (전 대통령) 어게인, 엠비(MB·이명박 전 대통령) 어게인까지 다 나와서 보수가 결집하는 것처럼 보이지 않냐”며 “선거가 잘못되면 이 대통령에게 큰일 난다. 이 대통령에 힘을 실어준다는 차원에서 민주당 후보에게 꼭 투표해달라”고 말했다. 정 대표는 “우리 민주개혁진보 진영이 더 결집해야 한다”며 “이 대통령을 지지하시는 국민 여러분은 투표장으로 꼭 나와 주시길 바란다”고 사전투표를 독려하기도 했다. 선거 막판 보수층의 결집 흐름이 감지되자 ‘위기’를 강조하며 지지층 결집에 나선 것이다.)

On this day, the Democratic Party leadership focused efforts to win over voters in competitive regions like Seoul and North Jeolla Province. Chung campaigned in Seoul and North Gyeongsang Province, while floor leader Han Byung-do visited Daegu and North Jeolla Province. As the close race continued between independent candidate Kim Kwan-young, former governor of North Jeolla Province expelled from the party over a 'cash envelope distribution' scandal, and Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek, Chung cited a Korea Welfare News-Gallup Korea poll (conducted on the 26th-27th; for details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website) showing Lee at 46% leading Kim at 38% by 8 percentage points, appealing for support for Lee and vowing to "pay more careful attention to the sentiments of the residents of North Jeolla Province." (이날 민주당 지도부는 서울, 전북 등 경합지역 표심을 잡기 위해 힘을 쏟았다. 정 대표는 서울과 경북을 찾아 지원 유세를 했고, 한병도 원내대표는 대구와 전북을 찾았다. ‘돈봉투 살포 의혹’으로 당에서 제명된 김관영 전북지사 무소속 후보와 이원택 민주당 후보의 접전 흐름이 계속되자 정 대표는 페이스북에 이 후보(46%)가 김 후보(38%)를 8%포인트 앞서는 것으로 나온 한국복지신문-한국갤럽 여론조사(26∼27일 조사. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조)를 인용하며 “전북도민의 심정을 더 세심하게 살피겠다”며 이 후보 지지를 호소했다.)

On this day, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk visited the Chungcheong region (Nonsan and Geumsan in South Chungcheong Province), where candidate Kim Tae-heum and Democratic candidate Park Soo-hyun are locked in a tight race, while floor leader Song Un-seok traveled to Daegu to support mayoral candidate Choo Kyung-ho. Former President Park Geun-hye, who had campaigned in Busan, Ulsan, and South Gyeongsang Province the previous day, continued her support tour by visiting Wonju and Hoengseong in Gangwon Province and then Mungyeong in North Gyeongsang Province. Meanwhile, Jang, during a campaign rally in Nonsan, South Chungcheong Province, criticized the government and ruling party's response to the Starbucks 'May 18 Tank Day' marketing controversy, stating, "The president is meddling in the coffee I buy and drink with my own money. If the local elections go wrong, we might end up living in a South Korea where even our breathing is controlled," taking a sharp jab at President Lee and the Democratic Party. (이날 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 김태흠 충남지사 후보와 박수현 민주당 후보가 접전을 벌이는 충남(논산·금산) 등 충청권을 찾았고, 송언석 원내대표는 대구를 찾아 추경호 대구시장 후보를 지원했다. 전날 부·울·경(부산·울산·경남)을 찾은 박근혜 전 대통령은 이날 강원도 원주, 횡성을 거쳐 경북 문경 지원 유세에 나섰다. 장 대표는 충남 논산 유세에서 스타벅스 ‘5·18 탱크데이’ 마케팅 논란에 대한 정부·여당의 대응을 언급하며 “내 돈 내고 내가 사 먹는 커피를 대통령이 간섭하고 있다. 지방선거 잘못하면 숨 쉬는 것까지 통제받는 대한민국에서 살지도 모른다”고 이 대통령과 민주당에 날을 세웠다.)

People Power Party election campaign chief Chung Hee-yong held a press conference at the party headquarters in Seoul, urging voters to turn out, saying, "If each of your supporters' votes come together, we can build a springboard for a comeback. I ask you, citizens who are disappointed in the arrogant administration and unqualified candidates, to come to the polls and give strength to our candidates for at least a minimal check on power." (정희용 국민의힘 선거대책본부장은 이날 서울 당사에서 기자간담회를 열어 “지지자들의 한 표 한 표가 모이면 역전의 발판이 마련될 수 있다”며 “오만한 정권과 자격 미달의 후보들에게 실망한 국민 여러분들께서 투표장으로 나오셔서 최소한의 견제를 위해 국민의힘 후보들에게 힘을 보태달라”고 투표를 독려했다.)

Following the collapse of the Seosomun elevated roadway in Seoul, Democratic candidate Jung Won-oh and People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon, who had suspended their campaigns, each held press conferences on this day, promoting early voting under the theme of 'Safe Seoul'. (서울 서소문 고가차도 붕괴 사고 이후 서울시장 선거운동을 멈췄던 정원오 민주당 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 후보도 이날 각각 기자간담회를 열어 ‘안전한 서울’을 화두로 사전투표 참여를 독려했다.)

Jung stated, "What a mayor prioritizes determines the direction of Seoul's administration," and pledged to establish a 'Life Safety Committee' directly under the mayor. Oh, commenting on the Seosomun elevated roadway collapse, said, "I feel a heavy sense of responsibility. We need a prepared mayor who can return to the site the day after the election and immediately begin resolving issues—leadership that people can trust and rely on. I will stay more alert and get things done." (정 후보는 “시장이 무엇을 중요하게 보느냐가 서울시정의 우선순위를 결정한다”며 ‘시장 직속 생명안전위원회’ 구성을 공약했다. 오 후보는 서소문 고가차도 붕괴 사고에 “무거운 책임감을 통감한다”며 “선거 다음날 바로 현장으로 돌아가 즉시 해결에 착수할 수 있는 준비된 시장, 믿고 맡길 수 있는 리더십이 필요하다. 더 정신 바짝 차리고 챙기겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr Reporter Ko Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Breaking] Kim Sang-wook Elected as Unified Candidate of Democratic and Progressive Parties for Ulsan Mayor ([속보] 김상욱, 울산시장 민주·진보 단일후보 선출)
item.description:
Kim Sang-wook, the candidate of the Democratic Party of Korea, has been elected as the unified candidate of the Democratic and Progressive parties for the Ulsan mayoral election on June 3. (김상욱 더불어민주당 후보가 6·3 지방선거 울산시장 민주·진보 단일후보로 선출됐다.)

On the 28th, a day before the advance voting for the June 3 local elections, the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party announced the results of the rerun of the Ulsan mayoral unified candidate selection in front of the Ulsan City Election Commission. (민주당과 진보당은 6·3 지방선거 사전투표를 하루 앞둔 28일 울산시 선거관리위원회 앞에서 울산시장 단일 후보 재경선 결과를 발표했다.)

Earlier, Candidate Kim Sang-wook and Candidate Kim Jong-hoon of the Progressive Party conducted a primary election on the same day from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. using a 100% secure phone number-based public opinion poll method. (앞서, 김상욱 후보와 김종훈 진보당 후보는 이날 오전 9시부터 오후 5시까지 안심번호 100% 시민 여론조사 방식의 경선을 진행했다.)

item.title: People Power Party shifts from ‘abolishing’ early voting to encouraging it… “Please vote with confidence” (국힘, 사전투표 ‘폐지’에서 독려로…“안심하고 투표해달라”)
item.description:
On the 28th, one day before the start of early voting (29th–30th) for the June 3 local elections and parliamentary by-elections, the People Power Party urged participation in early voting, stating it would “carefully examine and inspect the entire process.” This is an unusual move considering that the conservative camp has traditionally been negative toward early voting, citing poor management and other issues. <<> Jeong Hui-yong, secretary-general of the People Power Party, held a press briefing at the party’s headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, on the same day and said, “Voting begins tomorrow,” adding, “Citizens disappointed with the arrogant administration and unqualified candidates, please come out to the polling stations and lend strength to the People Power Party candidates who will serve as a minimal check on President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party of Korea.” Secretary-General Jeong further stated, “Regarding early voting, we will carefully examine and inspect the entire process to ensure there is nothing for you to worry about,” urging, “Please vote with confidence and cast your precious vote for the People Power Party candidate.” <<> Secretary-General Jeong fair, objective, and trustworthy election management, and strongly demanded that there be no flawed voting like in the past, such as basket voting or the external extraction of ballots.” He also available at the party level to ensure that citizens can vote with confidence.” This is interpreted as an effort to dispel the conservative camp’s distrust of early voting by stressing thorough vote management to boost early voter turnout among conservatives. <<> The People Power Party leadership is considering a strategy of distributing participation between early voting and regular voting. item.title: When asked about Park Geun-hye’s scandal... Ha Jung-woo, Park Min-sik, Han Dong-hoon spar sharply even with microphones off (박근혜 국정농단 묻자…하정우·박민식·한동훈, 마이크 꺼져도 날선 공방)
item.description:
“This election is a choice between a candidate endorsed by President Lee Jae-myung and Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party of Korea’s candidate for Busan mayor; a candidate nostalgic for the Yoon Suk-yeol administration; or a candidate from Gangnam who ignores the lives of ordinary people and only calls for restoring conservatism.” (Ha Jung-woo, Democratic Party of Korea candidate) (“이번 선거는 이재명 대통령과 전재수 더불어민주당 부산시장 후보에게 인정받은 후보냐, 윤석열 정권을 그리워하는 후보냐, 서민의 삶은 모르고 보수 복구만 외치는 강남 사람이냐의 선택이다.”(하정우 더불어민주당 후보))

“No resident trusts a candidate who comes down like a fly-by-night operation lasting a month and claims to develop a desperate Buk-gu.” (Park Min-sik, People Power Party candidate) (“한달짜리 ‘떴다방’처럼 내려와 절박한 북구를 발전시킨다는 말을 신뢰하는 주민은 없다.”(박민식 국민의힘 후보))

“Park Min-sik’s second term, and the third term of Jeon Jae-soo that Ha Jung-woo vows to continue. This is the result of 20 years. We need AS (after-sales service) for the ‘lost 20 years.’” (Han Dong-hoon, independent candidate) (“박민식 후보의 재선, 하정우 후보가 계승하겠다는 전재수 후보의 3선. 20년의 결과가 지금 이 모습이다. ‘잃어버린 20년’에 대한 에이에스(AS)가 필요하다.”(한동훈 무소속 후보))

Candidates Ha Jung-woo, Park Min-sik, and Han Dong-hoon engaged in fierce debates on the 28th during the first TV debate for the Busan Buk-gu by-election for the National Assembly, hosted by the National Election Broadcasting Debate Commission at Busan MBC’s studio in Dong-gu, Busan. The debate was heated, with candidates continuing their verbal sparring even after their microphones were cut off due to time limits. (하정우·박민식·한동훈 후보가 28일 부산 동구 부산문화방송(MBC) 스튜디오에서 열린 중앙선거방송토론위원회 주관 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보자 첫 티브이(TV) 토론에서 거친 공방을 벌였다. 토론회는 주어진 시간이 지나 마이크가 꺼진 상황에서도 후보들의 설전이 이어질 만큼 과열된 분위기로 진행됐다.)

The attacks focused on Han, who has been rising in recent polls. Ha brought up the appointment of former Grand National Party lawmaker Jeong Hyeong-geun as the chairman of Han’s campaign fundraising committee, saying, “He has installed someone who is the original color rhetorician and political prosecutor as the fundraising chairman.” Han responded, “It shows that anyone who agrees with the direction of rebuilding conservatism can join us.” Ha retorted, “This shows Han’s level of awareness about human rights,” adding, “If this is the case, I don’t understand why anyone would oppose Yoon Suk-yeol and the insurrectionist forces.” (최근 여론조사에서 상승세를 보이는 한 후보를 향한 공세가 집중됐다. 하 후보는 한 후보 캠프 후원회장으로 정형근 전 한나라당 의원이 위촉된 것을 거론하며 “색깔론, 정치검사 원조 격인 사람을 후원회장으로 앉혔다”고 말했다. 한 후보는 “보수 재건의 방향성에 공감한다면 누구라도 함께할 수 있다는 것을 보여드린 것”이라고 했다. 하 후보는 “한 후보의 인권에 대한 인식이 그 정도”라며 “이 정도면 윤석열과 내란 세력은 왜 반대했는지 이해가 안 된다”고 꼬집었다.)

Han asked Ha, “Do you support or oppose the withdrawal of the indictment?” This was an attempt to highlight the Democratic Party’s push for the so-called ‘law on special prosecution for fabricated indictments,’ which grants authority to withdraw indictments. Ha fired back, “Is this an interrogation room? Why are you asking for a yes or no?” When Han asked, “Who is the main enemy of South Korea?” Ha replied, “The defense white paper lists the North Korean military and the North Korean government. Why ask that again?” (한 후보는 하 후보에게 “공소취소 찬성하냐, 반대하냐”고 물었다. 민주당이 공소취소 권한이 부여된 이른바 ‘조작기소 특검법’을 추진하는 것을 부각하려 한 것이다. 하 후보는 “검사 취조실이냐, 왜 예스, 노로 묻냐”고 맞받아쳤다. 하 후보는 “대한민국 주적이 누구냐”는 한 후보 질문에는 “국방백서에 북한군과 북한 정부라고 나와 있는데 그걸 왜 또 물어보냐”고 답했다.)

Park focused on Han’s role as the prosecutor handling former President Park Geun-hye’s power abuse scandal. When Park said, “Aren’t you responsible for the case where you sought a 30-year prison sentence and a 118.5 billion won fine for former President Park in 2018?” Han responded, “I feel personally sorry to former President Park.” When Han then asked Park, “If it had to be one of Ha Jung-woo or Han Dong-hoon who wins, who would you prefer?” Park replied, “I am confident it will be Park Min-sik.” (박 후보는 한 후보가 박근혜 전 대통령 국정농단 사건 담당 검사였던 점을 집중 추궁했다. 박 후보가 “2018년 박 전 대통령에게 징역 30년, 벌금 1185억원을 구형한 사건에 책임이 있는 것 아니냐”고 하자, 한 후보는 “박 전 대통령에게 인간적으로 죄송한 마음이 있다”고 말했다. 한 후보가 박 후보에게 “하정우와 한동훈 중 한명이 당선돼야 한다면 누가 되길 바라나”라고 묻자, 박 후보는 “박민식이 된다고 확신한다”고 했다.)

When Ha questioned Han about the 2024 ‘party member bulletin board incident,’ which led to Han’s expulsion, Han scoffed, saying, “I didn’t expect Ha to bring this up.” Park then added, “It was an incident that deeply wounded our conservative supporters.” (또 한 후보 제명의 이유가 됐던 2024년 ‘당원게시판 사건’에 대해 하 후보가 질의하자 한 후보는 “하 후보가 이럴 줄 몰랐다”고 실소를 터뜨렸고, 박 후보는 이어 “우리 보수 지지층들 사이에 엄청난 상처를 준 사건”이라고 가세했다.)

The three candidates continued their war of nerves in their closing statements. Han said, “A vote for Park is a wasted vote, or a vote helping Ha, or a vote helping the Lee Jae-myung regime,” adding, “Please allow me to control the Lee Jae-myung regime’s rampage.” Park highlighted, “If elected, I am a three-term lawmaker who has served as a minister. I am the only candidate who has truly worked for Buk-gu.” Ha said, “I will bring government budgets, policies, projects, and people to Buk-gu. With the Lee Jae-myung, Jeon Jae-sso, and Ha Jung-woo invincible fleet, it’s possible.” (세 후보는 마무리 발언에서도 신경전을 이어갔다. 한 후보는 “박 후보에게 가는 표는 사표 내지는 하 후보를 돕는 표, 이재명 정권을 돕는 표”라며 “이재명 정권의 폭주를 제어하게 해달라”고 말했다. 박 후보는 “전 당선되면 장관 출신 3선 의원이다. 진짜로 북구를 위해 일해본 유일한 후보”라고 부각했다. 하 후보는 “정부의 예산, 정책, 사업, 사람. 북구로 끌고 오겠다. 이재명, 전재수, 하정우 무적함대면 가능하다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr  김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: PM Kim Min-seok, Rumored to Run for Party Leadership, Likely to Offer Resignation After June 3 Elections (‘당권 도전설’ 김민석 총리, 6·3선거 뒤 사의 표명할 듯)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok is reportedly set to offer his resignation to President Lee Jae-myung immediately after the June 3 local elections. Following this, Kim is expected to prepare to run in the Democratic Party of Korea's national convention scheduled for August. (김민석 국무총리가 6·3 지방선거 직후 이재명 대통령에게 사의를 밝힐 것으로 알려졌다. 이후 김 총리는 오는 8월 열릴 더불어민주당 전당대회 출마 준비에 들어갈 예정이다.)

A ruling party official said on the 28th, "It is highly likely that Prime Minister Kim will express his intention to resign around the weekend when the local elections conclude (June 6-7)." An individual close to Prime Minister Kim also stated, "Running in the national convention is a done deal. Unless unexpected variables arise in foreign or economic affairs, he will likely announce his resignation right after the local elections." However, since the wishes of President Lee Jae-myung, who holds the appointing authority, are crucial, the actual timing of Kim's departure will be determined by the president's judgment. <<> Prime Minister Kim is solidifying his intention to run for party leader in the Democratic Party's August national convention and is expanding his contacts with lawmakers. On the 19th, he had dinner with floor leader Han Byeong-do and other members of the party's leadership at the prime minister's official residence in Samcheong-dong. On the 11th and 12th, he held consecutive dinners with lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties who serve on the National Assembly's Land, Infrastructure and Transport Committee and the Political Affairs Committee. If he runs for party leader, he will compete with current leader Jeong Cheong-rae. <<> Prime Minister Kim is also voicing his opinions on major issues. Earlier this month, regarding the issue of supplementary investigative powers that will come to the fore with the launch of the Major Crimes Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Office in October, he conveyed to the Prosecution Reform Task Force under the Prime Minister's Office the need to abolish such powers. This is interpreted as an attempt to highlight his distinctiveness in response to Democratic Party members who strongly advocate for the abolition of supplementary investigative powers. <<> Candidates for the next prime minister are already being discussed. At the presidential office, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik and Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom are mentioned. Additionally, Minister of Trade, Industry and Energy Kim Jeong-gwan and Policy Committee Chair Han Jeong-ae, considered a party policy expert, are also being floated. <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 여권 관계자는 28일 “김 총리가 지방선거가 끝나는 주말(6월6∼7일)께 사의를 표명할 가능성이 크다”고 말했다. 김 총리와 가까운 인사도 “전당대회 출마는 정해진 것이다. 외교, 경제에서 돌발 변수가 터지지 않는 한 지방선거 직후 사의를 표명할 것 같다”고 말했다. 다만 인사권자인 이재명 대통령의 뜻이 중요한 만큼, 김 총리가 실제 물러나는 시점은 이 대통령의 판단에 따라 결정될 것으로 보인다.)
